    The microphone ROG Carnyx is designed for live streaming and in-game communication. It features a 25 mm studio-quality condenser capsule that captures fine sound nuances and provides a warm sound image, a high-pass filter and a built-in pop filter. Metal, which is used for the shock mount, for example, plays a crucial role in terms of materials. Elastic suspension cables absorb desktop vibrations.
